quests.title: The Counter
quests.giver: Maeve Hanna, at the post counter
quests.summary: The postmaster at Bushmills retires at Easter, and the counter goes with her unless somebody takes it on. Volunteers, a convenience group and the craft shop each have a plan. Hear them all, then tell her what you think.

steps.text: Hear Margaret Cuthbert, the retired teacher, in the post office.
Hear Gareth Boyd, from the convenience group.
Hear Joanne Hill at the craft shop.
Wait for word. The post comes through the van and the post office, a night's sleep or a day later.

quests.reward: An Ulster cardigan, a keepsake of the counter, and Maeve's soda farl recipe.

endings.text: Volunteers took the counter on, three mornings a week from a biscuit tin. The shop shelves are gone, and so far the rota has held.
A convenience group took the counter and the shop. It is open seven days, three people from the town have jobs and the parcels are on time.
The counter moved to a hatch in the back of the craft shop, open Tuesday to Saturday. Mondays are quiet, and the craft shop has had its best summer.
